title: Address to Ambrose and Protoctetus
english: To Ambrose and Protoctetus, beloved: in the present contest we must urge one another toward martyrdom and not be ashamed to confess Christ [[before the nations >> Bible:Matthew 10:32-33]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2 Exhortatio (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Do not be ashamed of Christ; love God with the whole soul (chs. 1–2)
english: [[Do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord >> Bible:2 Timothy 1:8]]. Love God with the whole soul, and keep in mind the contest set before you, as athletes of a better crown.
translator_notes: Copy-text Koetschau GCS 2 Exhortatio (OCR); no O’Meara/Greer wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
